title: Technicians start in order of first name, last name, then account age
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Eligible technicians including two with the same first name and two with an identical full name (different staff records).
  5. No manual order saved yet.
custom_steps:
1. Switch to Tech View without reordering anything.
  2. Read the technician order top to bottom.
  3. Confirm first-name A–Z, then last-name A–Z, then the earliest-created record for identical names.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Technicians are initially ordered by first name A-Z, then last name A-Z.
  • Technicians with identical names are ordered by when their user account was created, oldest first and newest last.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10045 — Tech View. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S2-R3 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
